OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t,
  CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'January%' THEN 1
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'February%' THEN 2
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'March%' THEN 3
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'April%' THEN 4
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'May%' THEN 5
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'June%' THEN 6
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'July%' THEN 7
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'August%' THEN 8
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'September%' THEN 9
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'October%' THEN 10
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'November%' THEN 11
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE 'December%' THEN 12
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
    ELSE CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '([0-9]{1,2}),', 1) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WITH p, t, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month * 100 + birth_day > 1014 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
